bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root=
for p in /home/gace/Project/Gserver/repository /home/gace/Project/server-core /home/gace/Project/Gserver/server-core;do
 if test -f "$p/scripts/servercore_host_output_export.py";then root="$p";break;fi
done
if test -z "$root";then
 path="$(find /home/gace/Project -maxdepth 7 -type f -name servercore_host_output_export.py -print -quit 2>/dev/null)"
 if test -n "$path";then root="$(dirname "$(dirname "$path")")";fi
fi
test -n "$root" || exit 61
cd "$root"
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from scripts.servercore_host_output_export import load_record
rid='req_20261120232000000000e106'
ledger=Path.home()/'.local/state/gserver-terminal/results'
r=load_record(rid,ledger)
if r.get('exit_code')!=80:sys.exit(62)
s=(r.get('stdout') or '')+'\n'+(r.get('stderr') or '')
labels=['description_panel','review_version_marker','review_terms','wizard_import','wizard_preview_anchor','wizard_next_screen','wizard_waiting','wizard_render','paid_media_caption','sales_summary','sales_history']

sys.exit(100+hits[0])
